name: AgentShop
author: agentShop

sections.description:
AgentShop helps WooCommerce store owners understand and optimize traffic coming from AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Features

  • LLM Traffic Tracking – Automatically detect and track visitors referred from AI assistants
  • Conversion Analytics – Track the full customer journey from page view to purchase
  • Real-time Events – Server-side and client-side event tracking for accurate data
  • GDPR Compliant – Built-in privacy controls and data export/erasure support
  • llms.txt Support – Automatically serve llms.txt for AI assistant discovery

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect your store to AgentShop with one click
  3. Start tracking LLM-driven traffic automatically

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • HTTPS enabled (required for blog publishing feature)

Third-Party Service

This plugin connects to the AgentShop service to provide analytics and tracking functionality.

Service Provider: AgentShop (https://useagentshop.com)

Data Transmitted:

  • Page view events (URL, timestamp, referrer)
  • Product view events (product ID, name, price)
  • Add to cart events (product details, quantity)
  • Order events (order ID, total, items – no personal customer data)
  • LLM/AI referral source detection
  • Anonymous visitor identifiers

When Data is Sent:

  • When visitors browse your store (page views, product views)
  • When visitors add items to cart
  • When orders are placed
  • During webhook delivery for real-time sync

Links:

  • Service Website: https://useagentshop.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://useagentshop.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://useagentshop.com/terms

Cookies

This plugin uses the following cookies:

  • agentshop_cid – Stores a unique customer identifier for analytics. Expires after 2 years.
  • agentshop_sid – Stores a session identifier. Expires when the browser is closed.
  • agentshop_llm – Stores the detected LLM/AI source for attribution. Expires after 30 days.

All cookies are first-party cookies set on your domain. No third-party tracking cookies are used.

Privacy Policy

AgentShop is designed with privacy in mind:

Data Collection

  • Analytics data is collected only when tracking is enabled in settings
  • Customer data is anonymized before transmission
  • No personal data is stored locally beyond order metadata

GDPR Compliance

  • Integrates with WordPress privacy tools for data export and erasure
  • Provides suggested privacy policy text for your site
  • Respects Do Not Track browser settings (when enabled in settings)

Data Retention

  • Local tracking metadata is tied to WooCommerce order retention
  • Data on AgentShop servers follows our data retention policy at https://useagentshop.com/privacy

User Rights

Users can request data export or deletion through WordPress privacy tools or by contacting the store administrator.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/agentshop/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > AgentShop to connect your store
sections.faq:
Do I need an AgentShop account?

Yes, you’ll need a free AgentShop account to use this plugin. You can sign up at https://app.useagentshop.com/sign-up

Is my data secure?

Yes, all data is transmitted securely over HTTPS and we follow industry best practices for data protection.

Does this work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Does this work with Cart and Checkout Blocks?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.

What data does AgentShop collect?

AgentShop collects anonymous analytics data including page views, product interactions, and order events. No personally identifiable information (PII) is collected or stored without explicit consent. See the “Third-Party Service” section for full details.

How do I delete my data?

You can use WordPress’s built-in privacy tools (Tools > Export/Erase Personal Data) to export or delete AgentShop tracking data associated with customer email addresses. For complete deletion from AgentShop servers, contact info@useagentshop.com.

1.0.0

  • LLM source detection for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok
  • Server-side order tracking
  • Client-side pixel tracking
  • Webhook integration for real-time events
  • llms.txt support
  • GDPR data export and erasure
  • Blog publishing via Application Passwords
